name: solera
description: AI-driven project workflow with a mindmap canvas. Four views (Service / Plan / Build / Live) over .solera/ data. Bundles an MCP server so Copilot / Claude / Gemini and any VSCode AI assistant can read the same graph.

solera.command.description: Shell command that launches the Solera MCP server. Invoked in the workspace folder. Default assumes `uv` is on PATH and the `solera-mcp` Python package is resolvable.

solera.port.description: Local HTTP port the spawned server binds to (also used by the webview to talk to it).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run copy-viewer && npm run compile
scripts.copy-viewer: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.resolve('../viewer/dist');const dst=path.resolve('media/viewer');fs.rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});function cp(s,d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name),dp=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(dp,{recursive:true});cp(sp,dp);}else{fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp);}}}cp(src,dst);console.log('Copied viewer dist to media/viewer/');"
